title: Account connections
subtitle: Sign in with your own accounts, so agents work with your permissions.
disabledBody: An operator turns this page on by pointing DASHBOARD_CONNECTIONS_FILE at a file that lists the sign-in commands to offer.
configErrorTitle: The connections file could not be loaded
emptyTitle: The connections file lists no connections

steps.open: Open the sign-in page in your browser and approve the request.
steps.code: Enter this code when the page asks for it:
steps.paste: Paste the address of the page you were sent to:
steps.pasteHint: After you approve, your browser may land on a page that fails to load. That is expected: copy the full address from the address bar and paste it here.
steps.otherLinks: Other links the sign-in command printed
steps.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in…

result.timeout: The sign-in timed out. Start it again.

onboarding.title: One last step: connect your accounts
onboarding.body: Your workspace needs these accounts before it can fetch your project's code. Sign in with your own account; agents will then work with your permissions.
onboarding.laterHint: You can connect later from the Accounts page.
onboarding.doneBody: Your accounts are connected and your workspace is ready.
onboarding.projectsBody: Pick the projects you work on. Their repositories are fetched into your workspace; you can add more later from the Accounts page.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Pick the projects you work on to fetch their repositories into your workspace. You can add more at any time.
projects.requires: Connect {{name}} first: fetching a project's code needs it.
projects.loadFailed: Could not load the project catalog
projects.configError: The project catalog could not be read

noAccess.title: You don't have access to this project's repositories.
noAccess.body: Ask DevOps for access to the repository, or wait ten years for someone to add you. Once you have it, press Try again.
